capabilities: Replace pasted URLs with Markdown links
Fetch page titles from Open Graph, Twitter, or HTML metadata
Use YouTube oEmbed for video links
Configure display templates and proxy settings
extras: The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and is pending approval; manual installation instructions are included.
problem: Pasting a URL leaves a bare link, and manually looking up page titles and icons to build Markdown links is tedious.
summary: Paste helper that converts a pasted HTTP(S) URL into a Markdown link with the page title, favicon, and a configurable display template.
